plumbing.review:
Two implementation fixes are needed:

- **Reject bare archive filenames before Docker.** [python_deps.go:459](python_deps.go:459) accepts `package-1.0.tar.gz` and `packaging-24.2-py3-none-any.whl` as package names. Pip interprets them as local archives, violating the planned early rejection. Add regressions for bare archive names in every input role.

- **Reject malformed include whitespace instead of repairing it.** [python_deps.go:299](python_deps.go:299) removes `=` and trims the argument, accepting `--requirement= deps/application.txt`; pip receives an empty option value and fails. It also strips a nonbreaking space from `-r\u00a0deps/application.txt`, changing the filename pip would read. Add rejection regressions for both forms.

Two required merge conditions remain unverified:

- The supplied [tests.txt:64](tests.txt:64) does not demonstrate the final-head real suite required by [README.md:136](README.md:136). Post its passing output after fixing these cases.
- The changed SPEC bullets lack the new dependency-policy decision citation; see [SPEC.md:65](SPEC.md:65). The merger must record that decision and cite it throughout, as [README.md:142](README.md:142) requires.

Otherwise, the patch stays within scope. Acceptance sources match the ratified plan; I found no weakened tests, test-specific production behavior, unintended host/network access, secret exposure, or material style mismatch. This was read-only inspection; I did not rerun tests.

VERDICT: changes needed — fix both parser gaps, add regressions, post passing final-head real-suite output, and complete the decision record and SPEC citations.
